usage: kkafio_cli [-h] [--config PATH] [--instance N|context-menu] COMMAND ...

KKAFIO — Koikatsu file I/O automation tool

positional arguments:
  COMMAND
    list-instances      List all instance names and their indices
    run                 Run all enabled tasks in instance order
    install-contents    Copy cards / mods / overlays into the game
    uninstall-contents  Remove cards / mods from the game
    filter-convert-kks  Convert KKS cards and scenes to KK and/or sort each type into its own
                        folder
    download-contents   Download character cards from db.bepis.moe or koikatsucards.com
    download-missing-mods
                        Find mods referenced by chara cards but missing locally, then download
                        them
    export-mods         Find zipmods by GUID and copy them into an output folder
    delete-unused-mods  Send zipmods not used by any chara, scene or coordinate card to the
                        recycle bin
    compress-cards-textures
                        Recompress the textures inside chara/coordinate cards with KoiCardTexTool
    delete-cards        Send character cards, coordinate cards, or Studio scenes and their
                        associated mods/coords to the recycle bin
    archive-cards       Bundle character cards, coordinate cards, or Studio scenes with their
                        zipmods and matching coordinates
    ungroup-cards       Move cards (chara, scenes, coordinates) from subfolders back to the top-
                        level folder
    rename-chara        Translate character card names to English using an LLM (shows a native
                        Copy/Paste dialog when it runs)
    group-scenes         Move Studio scenes into per-author folders using the pepper-scene-index
    group-chara         Move character cards into series subfolders using an LLM (shows a native
                        Copy/Paste dialog when it runs)
    filter-duplicate-contents
                        Find and handle duplicate PNG cards and zipmod files
    create-backup       Create a 7-Zip backup of game folders

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config PATH, -c PATH
                        Path to a config.json file (default: %APPDATA%/KKAFIO/config/mxu-
                        KKAFIO.json)
  --instance N|context-menu, -n N|context-menu
                        Zero-based index of the instance to use (default: 0), or 'context-menu'
                        for the instance marked "Use in Explorer Context Menu" in MXU (first
                        instance if none is marked). Run 'list-instances' to see all available
                        instances.

kkafio_cli.py — CLI entry point for KKAFIO
===========================================

Task commands (arguments override config; omit to use config value):
    kkafio_cli run
    kkafio_cli install-contents [--input DIR]
    kkafio_cli uninstall-contents  [--input DIR]
    kkafio_cli filter-convert-kks        [--input DIR] [--convert | --no-convert]
                             [--kk-action {Keep,Move,Delete}] [--kks-action {Keep,Move,Delete}]
    kkafio_cli create-backup [--output DIR] [--filename NAME]
                             [--mods | --no-mods]
                             [--userdata | --no-userdata]
                             [--bepinex | --no-bepinex]
    kkafio_cli list-instances

Shell context menu:
    Run kkafio_setup.bat and choose "Register context menu" to add KKAFIO to
    the Explorer right-click menu (no Administrator required). Choose
    "Unregister context menu" to remove it.

Global options:
    --config PATH   use a custom config.json instead of %APPDATA%/KKAFIO/config/mxu-KKAFIO.json
    --instance N    use instance N from the config (0-based, default: 0).
                    Use "--instance context-menu" to pick the instance that is
                    marked "Use in Explorer Context Menu" in MXU (right-click a
                    tab); falls back to instance 0 if none is marked. The
                    registered Explorer context-menu entries pass this.
archive-cards:
usage: kkafio_cli archive-cards [-h] [--format {7z,zip,copy}] [--auto-resolve | --no-auto-resolve]
                                [--use-cache | --no-use-cache]
                                [--include-modpack | --no-include-modpack]
                                [--combined | --no-combined]
                                [--include-coordinates | --no-include-coordinates]
                                [--mods-dir DIR] [--coord-dir DIR] [--output-dir DIR]
                                [--context-menu]
                                [CONTENT ...]

positional arguments:
  CONTENT               Character/coordinate/scene PNG paths (default: ArchiveCards.ContentPaths
                        from config)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {7z,zip,copy}
                        Archive format, or 'copy' to copy the files flat into a destination folder
                        instead of archiving them (default: ArchiveCards.Format from config)
  --auto-resolve        Auto-resolve mods and coord dirs (overrides config)
  --no-auto-resolve     Disable auto-resolution (overrides config)
  --use-cache           Cache mod/coord directory scans (overrides config)
  --no-use-cache        Disable cache and do a full scan (overrides config)
  --include-modpack     Include zipmods from Sideloader Modpack folders (overrides config)
  --no-include-modpack  Exclude Sideloader Modpack zipmods (overrides config)
  --combined            Put all cards in one archive (overrides config)
  --no-combined         One archive per card (overrides config)
  --include-coordinates
                        When archiving a character card, also bundle its matching coordinate cards
                        and their mods (default: on)
  --no-include-coordinates
                        Only bundle the character card itself, leave its coordinates out
  --mods-dir DIR        Mods directory override (only used when --no-auto-resolve)
  --coord-dir DIR       Coordinate directory override
  --output-dir DIR      Output directory (default: same folder as chara card/scene)
  --context-menu        Internal flag set by the context menu (via kkafio_setup.bat): coalesces
                        multiple simultaneous Explorer-selection invocations (one per selected
                        file) into a single combined run instead of processing each file
                        separately, and defaults --output-dir to the common parent folder of the
                        selection.

delete-cards:
usage: kkafio_cli delete-cards [-h] [--check-shared-mods | --no-check-shared-mods]
                               [--auto-resolve | --no-auto-resolve] [--use-cache | --no-use-cache]
                               [--include-coordinates | --no-include-coordinates] [--mods-dir DIR]
                               [--chara-dir DIR] [--scene-dir DIR] [--coord-dir DIR]
                               [--context-menu]
                               [CONTENT ...]

positional arguments:
  CONTENT               Character/coordinate/scene PNG paths (default: DeleteCards.ContentPaths
                        from config)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --check-shared-mods   Before deleting a zipmod, verify no other installed
                        character/scene/coordinate still uses it (default: on)
  --no-check-shared-mods
                        Skip the shared-mod check — faster, but may delete mods other characters
                        still need
  --auto-resolve        Auto-resolve mods and coord dirs (overrides config)
  --no-auto-resolve     Use explicit --mods-dir / --coord-dir instead
  --use-cache           Cache mod/coord directory scans (overrides config)
  --no-use-cache        Disable cache and do a full scan (overrides config)
  --include-coordinates
                        When deleting a character card, also delete its matching coordinate cards
                        and their mods (default: on)
  --no-include-coordinates
                        Only delete the character card itself, leave its coordinates alone
  --mods-dir DIR        Mods directory (only used when --no-auto-resolve)
  --chara-dir DIR       Custom chara directory for the shared-mod check (default: game's chara
                        folders)
  --scene-dir DIR       Custom scene directory for the shared-mod check (default: game's Studio
                        scene folder)
  --coord-dir DIR       Coordinate directory (used for coordinate matching when --no-auto-resolve,
                        and for the shared-mod check; default: game's coordinate folder)
  --context-menu        Internal flag set by the context menu (via kkafio_setup.bat): coalesces
                        multiple simultaneous Explorer-selection invocations (one per selected
                        file) into a single combined run instead of processing each file
                        separately.
delete-unused-mods:
usage: kkafio_cli delete-unused-mods [-h] [--exceptions TEXT | --exceptions-file FILE]
                                     [--use-cache | --no-use-cache] [--mods-dir DIR]
                                     [--chara-dir DIR] [--scene-dir DIR] [--coord-dir DIR]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --exceptions TEXT     Exception list, one entry per line: 'Folder\\' (ends in a slash) protects
                        a folder inside mods, a name ending in .zip/.zipmod protects that file,
                        anything else is a GUID. (default: DeleteUnusedMods.ExceptionList from
                        config)
  --exceptions-file FILE
                        Read the exception list from a text file instead
  --use-cache           Use the mods/card caches to skip re-scanning unchanged files (default: on)
  --no-use-cache        Disable cache and do a full scan
  --mods-dir DIR        Override the mods directory (default: game mods dir from config)
  --chara-dir DIR       Custom chara directory (default: game's chara folders)
  --scene-dir DIR       Custom scene directory (default: game's Studio scene folder)
  --coord-dir DIR       Custom coordinate directory (default: game's coordinate folder)

download-missing-mods:
usage: kkafio_cli download-missing-mods [-h] [--input-mods-dir DIR] [--output-mods-dir DIR]
                                        [--mods-dir DIR] [--chara-dir DIR] [--scene-dir DIR]
                                        [--coord-dir DIR] [--no-chara] [--no-scene] [--no-coord]
                                        [--use-cache | --no-use-cache]
                                        [--open-report | --no-open-report]
                                        [--modpack-mode {Skip,OnlyUsed,All}]
                                        [--telegram-source {No,KoikatsuCards,ChatLinks,Both}]
                                        [--telegram-chat-links LINKS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --input-mods-dir DIR  Mods directory whose installed mods count as present (default: game mods
                        dir from config)
  --output-mods-dir DIR
                        Mods directory that missing mods are downloaded into; its installed mods
                        also count as present (default: game mods dir from config)
  --mods-dir DIR        Legacy shorthand: use DIR as both --input-mods-dir and --output-mods-dir
  --chara-dir DIR       Override the chara directory to scan (default: game chara dirs from
                        config)
  --scene-dir DIR       Override the Studio scene directory to scan (default: game scene dir from
                        config, if Studio is installed)
  --coord-dir DIR       Override the coordinate directory to scan (default: game coordinate dir
                        from config)
  --no-chara            Skip scanning character cards for referenced mod GUIDs
  --no-scene            Skip scanning Studio scenes for referenced mod GUIDs
  --no-coord            Skip scanning coordinate cards for referenced mod GUIDs
  --use-cache           Use mods and chara cache to skip scanning (default: on)
  --no-use-cache
  --open-report         Open the report when mods are still missing or a download failed (default:
                        on)
  --no-open-report      Never open the report automatically
  --modpack-mode {Skip,OnlyUsed,All}
                        How to handle Sideloader Modpack mods: Skip=ignore modpack entirely,
                        OnlyUsed=download missing mods used by chara (default), All=download all
                        missing modpack mods
  --telegram-source {No,KoikatsuCards,ChatLinks,Both}
                        Where to look for mods not covered by BetterRepack: No=don't use Telegram
                        (default), KoikatsuCards=look up each GUID on koikatsucards.com,
                        ChatLinks=search the chats in --telegram-chat-links directly, Both=try
                        koikatsucards.com first, then ChatLinks for anything it couldn't find
  --telegram-chat-links LINKS
                        Newline-separated Telegram chat/channel/group links to search (one per
                        line; add a topic ID like .../299 to search only that forum topic; a
                        trailing '# comment' is ignored). Only used when --telegram-source is
                        ChatLinks or Both. Default: the two example chats shipped in the config.

filter-duplicate-contents:
usage: kkafio_cli filter-duplicate-contents [-h] [--input DIR] [--chara | --no-chara]
                                            [--mods | --no-mods] [--coords | --no-coords]
                                            [--scenes | --no-scenes] [--overlays | --no-overlays]
                                            [--chara-dir DIR] [--scene-dir DIR] [--coord-dir DIR]
                                            [--mods-dir DIR] [--overlays-dir DIR]
                                            [--fuzzy | --no-fuzzy] [--keep STRATEGY]
                                            [--action {move-rename,move,delete}]
                                            [--use-cache | --no-use-cache]

Scans the game's chara, scene, coordinate, mods and overlays folders (or the custom directories
given) recursively for duplicate PNG cards and zipmod files. Duplicates are identified by content
(not filename). By default they are moved to a _duplicates_/ subfolder and renamed. With --action
delete they are sent to the recycle bin instead.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --input DIR, -i DIR   Scan this one folder for every selected content type, instead of the per-
                        type directories (shorthand for setting all five --*-dir options)
  --chara
  --no-chara
  --mods
  --no-mods
  --coords
  --no-coords
  --scenes
  --no-scenes
  --overlays
  --no-overlays
  --chara-dir DIR       Custom chara directory (default: the game's female and male chara folders)
  --scene-dir DIR       Custom scene directory (default: the game's Studio scene folder)
  --coord-dir DIR       Custom coordinate directory (default: the game's coordinate folder)
  --mods-dir DIR        Custom mods directory (default: the game's mods folder)
  --overlays-dir DIR    Custom overlays directory (default: the game's Overlays folder)
  --fuzzy               Enable fuzzy matching for chara cards (overrides config)
  --no-fuzzy            Disable fuzzy matching (overrides config)
  --keep STRATEGY       Which copy to keep as the original (overrides config)
  --action {move-rename,move,delete}
                        What to do with duplicates (overrides config). 'move-rename' (default)
                        moves duplicates to _duplicates_/ and renames them after the kept copy (or
                        the first duplicate found, if --keep is 'None'), with a number suffix.
                        'move' moves them to _duplicates_/ keeping their original filenames.
                        'delete' sends them straight to the recycle bin.
  --use-cache           Cache file hashes (and phashes, for fuzzy matching) to speed up repeat
                        scans (overrides config)
  --no-use-cache        Disable cache and re-hash every file (overrides config)
